ns2:section.sectionText: Registration is restricted to FSHN majors and FS minors until the beginning of freshman registration. Any available seats will then be made available to ABE and ChemE majors. If you get a 'course full' error message and want to be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in August. Until that time, it is up to you to continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you.
